content.title: TS-150
content.lead: Local refrigeration unit for air conditioning of development headings, roadways, crosscuts and longwall faces.
content.shortDescription: Unit designed for direct air cooling in underground mine workings.

seo.title: TS-150 | Termospec
seo.description: TS-150 refrigeration unit for cooling air in underground mine workings.

components: Machinery unit with compressor, motor and condenser
Evaporator serving as an air cooler
features: Direct air cooling at the evaporator
Option to operate with an open or closed condenser cooling system
Suitable for use in explosion-hazardous mine workings
serviceScope: Selection of cooling capacity and unit configuration according to mine working conditions
Manufacturing and preparation of the unit for operation in demanding mining environments
Commissioning support and integration with the condenser cooling circuit
Service, inspections and upgrades of refrigeration system components

sections.title: Application
sections.body: In underground hard coal mines, local refrigeration units are used for air conditioning of development headings, driven roadways, crosscuts and longwall faces.

sections.title: Operating principle
sections.body: The evaporator is used for direct air cooling as an air cooler. Air flowing through the evaporator at a temperature above 26 °C is cooled by 10–14 °C.

sections.title: Cooling circuit
sections.body: Warm water from the condenser cooling circuit is cooled in evaporative water coolers. A system for direct condenser cooling with process water may also be used.
